turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so start with who decided that and on what basis.
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
I'm not here to discuss what Owen says in class, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and on what basis.
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then why does a kind kid have a zero, Hale? Save the character reference. What do you have besides that machine?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
Nobody said he cheated, Hale, except you just now. You're leading me, and I've done this for twenty years. Show me a document or I'm going upstairs.
